metadata.question: On July 7, was the year-to-date rainfall in the coastal city of La Serena lower than the 1990-2020 average for the same period?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Collection: UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY (daily precipitation, 1981–present).
- Location: La Serena, Chile (Point: [-71.2489, -29.9045]), buffered 10 km.
- Date: Year-to-date from Jan 1 to Jul 7 (inclusive) -> filterDate(year-01-01, year-07-08).
- Target Year: Choose the most recent year (from current year backward to 1990) where the YTD collection is non-empty at the location.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Not applicable (CHIRPS is precipitation; no cloud masking needed).

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- 0 mm is valid. Treat as valid if mean is finite and within [0, 5000] mm.
- If collection size == 0 → try earlier years; if none → C1.
- If after processing, valid pixel count == 0 → C2.
- If mean is null/NaN/out of range → C3.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  // Helpers
  function getInfoAsync(obj) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => obj.getInfo(resolve, reject));
  }
  async function ytdStatsForYear(year, geom, scale) {
    const col = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY')
      .filterBounds(geom)
      .filterDate(`${year}-01-01`, `${year}-07-08`)
      .select('precipitation');
    const size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
    if (!size || size === 0) {
      return {year, imgCount: size || 0, mean: null, pixCount: 0};
    }
    const sumImg = col.sum().rename('ytd');
    const dict = await getInfoAsync(sumImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}),
      geometry: geom,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }));
    const mean = dict ? dict['ytd_mean'] : null;
    const pixCount = dict ? dict['ytd_count'] : 0;
    return {year, imgCount: size, mean, pixCount};
  }
  function isValidRain(v) {
    return v !== null && isFinite(v) && v >= 0 && v <= 5000;
  }

  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const pt = ee.Geometry.Point([-71.2489, -29.9045]);
    const geom = pt.buffer(10000); // 10 km buffer
    const scale = 6000;

    // 2. Determine target year (latest year with any YTD images)
    const now = new Date();
    let targetYear = now.getUTCFullYear();
    let targetStats = null;
    for (let y = targetYear; y >= 1990; y--) {
      const stats = await ytdStatsForYear(y, geom, scale);
      if (stats.imgCount > 0) { targetYear = y; targetStats = stats; break; }
    }
    if (!targetStats) {
      console.log("Target YTD images: 0 (no data found for 1990+)");
      console.log("C1");
      return;
    }
    // 3. Validate target pixels
    if (!targetStats.pixCount || targetStats.pixCount === 0) {
      console.log(`Year ${targetYear} YTD images: ${targetStats.imgCount}, valid pixels: 0`);
      console.log("C2");
      return;
    }
    if (!isValidRain(targetStats.mean)) {
      console.log(`Year ${targetYear} YTD mean invalid: ${targetStats.mean}`);
      console.log("C3");
      return;
    }

    // 4. Baseline 1990-2020
    const startBase = 1990;
    const endBase = 2020;
    let baseVals = [];
    let baseHasImgs = 0;
    let baseHasPix = 0;
    for (let y = startBase; y <= endBase; y++) {
      const s = await ytdStatsForYear(y, geom, scale);
      if (s.imgCount > 0) baseHasImgs++;
      if (s.pixCount > 0 && isValidRain(s.mean)) {
        baseHasPix++;
        baseVals.push(s.mean);
      }
    }
    if (baseHasImgs === 0) {
      console.log("Baseline: 0 images across 1990-2020.");
      console.log("C1");
      return;
    }
    if (baseVals.length === 0) {
      console.log(`Baseline: images present (${baseHasImgs}) but 0 valid pixel years.`);
      console.log("C2");
      return;
    }
    const baseMean = baseVals.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / baseVals.length;

    // 5. Output concise evidence and final answer
    console.log(`Location: La Serena, 10km buffer. Scale: ${scale} m`);
    console.log(`Target Year: ${targetYear} | YTD imgs: ${targetStats.imgCount} | Pixels: ${targetStats.pixCount}`);
    console.log(`YTD Rain (mm): ${targetStats.mean.toFixed(2)}`);
    console.log(`Baseline 1990-2020 | Years used: ${baseVals.length}/31`);
    console.log(`Baseline Rain (mm): ${baseMean.toFixed(2)}`);
    const answer = (targetStats.mean < baseMean) ? "A" : "B";
    console.log(answer);
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`);
    console.log("D");
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
